Red Cliff

Road Book · checked Nov 23, 2026 · not saved yet

⌂ CatalogBeforeD1D2D3Help

Three days, two nights in Red Cliff. One stretch is closed now: two miles of Turquoise Lake Road on day 1 (the way around is a shorter day). Day 2 rides beside a closed asbestos area at Camp Hale: stay on the road.

Using it offline

  • Nothing to download: opening this page with a signal saves it. When the top says ✔ saved for offline, it's on this phone: page, maps, strips, GPX files and the weather.
  • Then open the same address without a signal. Easiest: in Chrome, ⋮ then Add to Home screen (iPhone: Share, then Add to Home Screen).
  • The night before, open it with a signal: that gets the latest version and a fresh forecast for the dates you set below.
  • It stays until you clear the browser's data. Try it once in airplane mode before you leave.

Weather and what to wear

At the hour you'd be at each place. Within 16 days: a forecast. Further out: the last five years.

Go or no-go

Your ticks stay on this device.

As of Nov 23, 2026: not a promise for your ride date.

  • ✖ Closed · Day 1, mile 176-178

    Turquoise Lake Road (CR 4)

    Barricaded for asphalt damage from Hagerman Pass to the Abe Lee turnoff since April 7, 2026, with no end date; still listed Sept 20. Our line rides exactly that stretch, after the north shore. Skip the lake (draft file), or ride the north shore in and back.

    Pike-San Isabel alert; also leadvilletwinlakes.com · ☎ Leadville Ranger District 719-486-0749

  • ⚠ Check · Day 1, mile 176-182

    Willow Fire closure

    The 2026 fire's edge is 0.3 mi from the line. The closure order (to Dec 31, 2026) covers the forest SOUTH of the lake road; the road itself is its edge.

    Order 02-12-01-26-39 · ☎ Leadville Ranger District 719-486-0749

  • ⚠ Check · Day 2, mile 5.7-6.3

    Camp Hale asbestos closure

    The line rides Resolution Road (FR 702) along the edge of a closed area on the order's map. The road is open to motorcycles on the Forest Service map (June 1 to Nov 15). Don't leave it or stop in the fields on its north side.

    Order WRNF 2012-16, in force · ☎ Eagle-Holy Cross 970-827-5715

  • ⚠ Check · Day 2, mile 41-83

    Independence Pass (CO 82)

    Closed for the winter Nov 3, 2026; opens around Memorial Day (May 21 in 2026). Closed? Red Cliff to Basalt by I-70 and CO 82 is 98 mi.

    CDOT, Nov 3, 2026

  • ⚠ Check · Day 2, mile 127-141

    Crooked Creek Pass (Eagle-Thomasville, FR 400)

    Opened after snowmelt: listed open by late June 2026. Crosses into the 2021 Sylvan burn (miles 139-146).

    Eagle-Holy Cross road status, June 2026 · ☎ Eagle-Holy Cross 970-827-5715

  • ⚠ Check · Day 2, mile 143-168

    Brush-Gypsum and Hardscrabble roads

    Seasonal: about June 1 to Nov 30 in the map data. Hardscrabble listed open in June 2026. Clay: not when wet.

    Eagle-Holy Cross road status, June 2026 · ☎ Eagle-Holy Cross 970-827-5715

  • ⚠ Check · Day 3, mile 0-11

    Shrine Pass (FR 709)

    Opens in May or June after snowmelt (tentatively May 1 in 2026; listed open by June). No notice for 2027 yet.

    Eagle-Holy Cross road status, 2026 · ☎ Eagle-Holy Cross 970-827-5715

  • ⚠ Check · Day 1, mile 61-85

    Guanella Pass

    Closes after Thanksgiving, opens around Memorial Day (six weeks early in 2026). Closed? I-70 to Frisco and CO 9 to Breckenridge, 38 mi.

    Clear Creek County · ☎ Clear Creek Road & Bridge 303-679-2422

  • ⚠ Check · Day 1, mile 104-124

    Boreas Pass Road

    Gates close for the winter; opens about mid to late May, later in a big snow year (TerraTrack's map data: closed January to April). No 2026 closure or damage notice found. Closed? US 285 and CO 9 over Hoosier Pass, 31 mi, paved.

    White River and Pike forests · ☎ Dillon Ranger District 970-468-5400; South Park 719-836-2031

  • ⚠ Check · Day 1 and Day 3, mile 50-60 (day 1), 48-69 (day 3)

    I-70 at Floyd Hill and Idaho Springs

    A long construction zone. Full closures so far are at night (last one found: Nov 2026). Weekend traffic east is heavy after noon.

    CDOT, Nov 9, 2026; live: cotrip.org

  • ⚠ Check · Day 1 and Day 3, mile 135 (day 1), 22 (day 3)

    I-70 exit 203, Frisco

    The interchange rebuild stops for the winter and starts again in April 2027, through October 2027: slow in Frisco.

    CDOT, Oct 2026

  • ✔ No issue found · Day 3, mile 12-22

    I-70, Vail Pass

    The West Vail Pass lanes project finished Nov 16, 2026.

    CDOT

  • ✔ No issue found · Day 3, mile 26-31

    Swan Mountain Road

    Rebuilt in 2025 and 2026; reopened in August 2026. No 2027 work found.

    Summit County

To do

  • 2-3 weeks before: call Leadville about Turquoise Lake Road; Eagle-Holy Cross about Shrine, Resolution, Hardscrabble and Crooked Creek.
  • The week before: CDOT on Independence Pass, Guanella and I-70; White River alerts; ask for a fresh Road Book check.
  • The night before: weather, fuel range for day 2 (90 miles), Mango's hours (dinner in Red Cliff).
  • In the bag: rain and warm layers (Independence 12,095 ft), tire repair, water, printed strip, breakfast food: no coffee shop found in Red Cliff.

If it goes wrong

  • Emergency 911. Assume no signal at Camp Hale, on the Frying Pan above Ruedi, Crooked Creek, Hardscrabble and Shrine.
  • Hospitals: St. Anthony Summit, Frisco; St. Vincent, Leadville; Aspen Valley. Clinics in Eagle, Idaho Springs.
  • Forest offices: Eagle-Holy Cross 970-827-5715; Leadville 719-486-0749.
  • Mid-July sunset is about 8:30 pm.

Desk-planned; distances can be off by a few tenths. Hours change: call. Not legal advice; the Forest Service's MVUM is the legal document. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors; relief: USGS The National Map; fire perimeters: NIFC.
